<center># Study 1 codebook processed data
<br>
<br>

Nr.       |Variable Name      | Variable Label            |  Variable Values 
----------|-------------------|---------------------------|-------------------------
1|id|Participant ID|-
2|condition|Experimental condition|1 = Harmonious; 2 = Conflicting
3|random_app|Context name randomization|1 = 1st "Eats", 2nd "Zanana"; 2 = 1st "Zanana", 2nd "Eats"
4|BMI|Body mass index|-
5|PES|Protestant ethic scale score|-
6|nutrition|Eating style |1 = Unrestricted; 2 = Pescetarian; 3 = Vegetarian; 4 = Vegan; 5 = Other
7|allergy|Food allergies or intolerances|1 = Yes; 2 = No 
8|base_tasty_c1|Estimated percentage of tasty foods in 1st context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
9|base_healthy_c1|Estimated percentage of healthy foods in 1st context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
10|base_tasty_c2|Estimated percentage of tasty foods in 2nd context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
11|base_healthy_c2|Estimated percentage of healthy foods in 2nd context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
12|condi_est_c1|Conditional contingency estimate 1st context|-
13|condi_est_c2|Conditional contingency estimate 2nd context|-
14|belief_ht_c1_R|1st context: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|1 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
15|belief_ht_c2_R|2nd context: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|2 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
16|belief_ht_overall_R|Across contexts: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|3 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
17|preference|Across contexts: What kind of food would you more likely order? (Preference)|1 = an unhealthy food; 11 = a healthy food
18|delivery|Frequency of ordering via delivery services|1 = Never; 2 = Rarely; 3 = Sometimes; 4 = Often
19|delivery_taste|Tastiness of food from usually used delivery services|1 = Not at all tasty; 100 = Very tasty
20|delivery_health|Health of food from usually used delivery services|1 = Not at all healthy; 100 = Very healthy
